shared_elements: low-relief carving on a vertical stone face
justification: Both show relief carving on upright stone slabs, and in each case a shallow-relief motif runs down the vertical face, which in B looks like an animal or limb form and in A is an elaborately costumed human figure; beyond this generic 'carved standing monolith' correspondence little is shared. A depicts a dense, frontal anthropomorphic figure with headdress, ornaments and framing glyph-like panels filling the whole surface, while B shows sparse, isolated low-relief motifs on a plain, largely empty block with no figural composition.
